mainEntity.name: Will AEO replace traditional SEO for contractors in the future?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO is unlikely to fully replace traditional SEO but will continue to grow in importance as search behavior evolves. Instead, AEO should be viewed as a complementary strategy that enhances your overall digital presence. Traditional SEO remains crucial for broad keyword rankings and driving website traffic, while AEO focuses on capturing direct answers and voice search queries. A comprehensive digital marketing strategy for contractors will integrate both AEO and traditional SEO to maximize visibility and lead generation.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO won't replace traditional SEO but will complement it, becoming increasingly important for direct answers and voice search. Both are vital for a comprehensive digital strategy.
